name: smooth-surfer
description: Make sites less attention-grabbing, filter posts with rules you write, delay distracting sites, and pin tabs across windows.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/smooth-surfer.zip && zip -r dist/smooth-surfer.zip manifest.json popup.html review.html filters.html welcome.html src icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png
